defects.defect: The large empty brown gap makes the primary action and navigation feel disconnected.
defects.direction: Reduce the gap or extend the level section so the vertical rhythm matches the tighter upper-stack spacing.
defects.region: between Play button and bottom navigation

defects.defect: Vertical rhythm is inconsistent — top bar→title gap (~30px) and title→scene gap (~25px) are tight while scene→map (~25px), map→Play (~40px) and Play→nav (~75px) differ noticeably; the Play button floats in a large empty band above the nav bar
defects.direction: Normalize inter-section gaps to a single spacing unit and reduce the dead space between Play and the nav bar so the stack reads as evenly spaced
defects.region: map panel bottom edge to Play button, y≈1140-1180; and Play button to nav bar, y≈1265-1340

defects.defect: Map panel is a mostly empty dark wooden slab: the level path is a short vertical strip in the center with two locked nodes and only node '2' unlocked, while the four corners hold unrelated decorative props (crates, tent, campfire, cactus) floating with no baseline — the area reads as unfinished placeholder rather than a designed level map
defects.direction: Extend the path into a winding route that uses the panel width, add more level nodes with varied placement, and anchor decor to the path/terrain instead of parking one prop per corner

defects.defect: Character name labels are plain drop-shadowed text sitting directly on the artwork with no plate or chip; 'Bastion' and 'Sage' land on busy light areas and lose legibility, and 'Bastion' is not centered under its character
defects.direction: Give each name a semi-transparent pill/banner backing and center it under the corresponding character

defects.defect: Top and bottom framed bars sit near the screen edges while the scene, map, and Play button are substantially inset.
defects.direction: Use a more deliberate shared margin system, or visually justify the full-bleed bars with stronger hierarchy.

defects.defect: vertical gap below the Play button (~90px) is noticeably larger than the consistent margins used between top bar, title, scene, map and button, leaving a plain background strip
defects.direction: tighten the Play-button-to-nav margin toward the same rhythm as the other inter-panel gaps, or enlarge the map panel slightly to absorb the slack
defects.region: between Play button and bottom nav bar

defects.defect: cells adjacent to the decorated corners (gold ore, tent, campfire, cactus) are bare dark wood, so the map interior reads a touch sparse/unfinished off the center path
defects.direction: add small low-contrast props or plank texture variation in the empty cells to fill the grid without competing with the level nodes
defects.region: level map panel interior, middle cells of top and bottom rows

defects.defect: The four resource chips are unequal widths (energy chip ≈180px vs crystal ≈150px) and their icon-to-number spacing varies, so the row reads ragged inside the frame
defects.direction: Equalize chip widths and use one consistent icon/value gap across all four resources

defects.defect: The Settings cell appears narrower than the other navigation cells.
defects.direction: Make all four navigation cells equal width and keep their icons and labels centered in each cell.

defects.defect: Play button width (≈640px) is narrower than the hero scene and map panels (≈678px), so the left/right edges of the vertical stack do not align to one common margin
defects.direction: Match the Play button's horizontal insets to the scene/map panel margins so all stacked elements share one gutter
defects.region: Play button vs. panels above, x≈40-680 vs x≈22-700

defects.defect: the purple lightning/sparkle accents around 'Mage Master' are weighted toward the upper-right, making the title decoration slightly asymmetric
defects.direction: balance the accent effects left/right around the lettering's vertical axis

defects.defect: the hero scene is a plain rounded rectangle while the top bar, level map and nav bar all carry the ornate gold frame, so it reads slightly less anchored than its framed siblings
